children.value: > Fact From Story: his employees told him “they were busy and I should stop asking questions because it was distracting.”
> Fact From Story: In June 2022, Bankman-Fried heard about the account called “fiat@ftx” tracking how much money Alameda owed to FTX, he testified.
> > Fact From Story: He did not know what it was and did not bother to find out.
> > > Fact From Story: His employees told him "I should stop asking questions because it was distracting.”
> > > Fact From Story: His employees told him “they were busy”.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Employees generally follow the directions of their boss, but SBF did not seem to be in charge.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People generally ask questions about things they don't understand, especially when those things are related to their business.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Employees work for and take direction from their bosses.
